shortDescription: Germany's TUI XETR:TUI1 narrowed its outlook for 2026 underlying operating earnings on Tuesday, saying demand was strong for its holiday experiences portfolio in the fourth quarter.The travel group now expects annual underlying earnings before interest and taxes to reach between €1.2 billion and €1…

children: narrowed its outlook for 2026 underlying operating earnings on Tuesday, saying demand was strong for its holiday experiences portfolio in the fourth quarter.

The travel group now expects annual underlying earnings before interest and taxes to reach between €1.2 billion and €1.3 billion ($1.4 billion and $1.5 billion), instead of the previously forecast €1.1 billion to €1.4 billion.
